subject: Recoding a matrix from numeric to the corresponding base calls

messages.author: 2dd292174e1ae914
messages.subject: Recoding a matrix from numeric to the corresponding base calls
parts:
Hello, 

I am trying to recode a matrix of DaRT data I created from the 0,1,2 calls into a matrix that gives the base calls ie AA or AT at each locus for my samples. Is there a way to do this in DartR? Any help is greatly appreciated!

Cheers, 

Colin Sobek

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Recoding a matrix from numeric to the corresponding base calls
parts:
Hi Colin,

Check code below. Note that calls in dartR are 0 = homozygote reference allele, 1= heterozygote and 2 = homozygote for the alternative allele.

Cheers,
Luis 

gl2calls <- function(x){
  x_mat <- as.matrix(x[, ])
  homs1 <- paste(substr(x...@loc.all, 1, 1), substr(x...@loc.all, 1, 1), sep = "")
  hets <- x...@loc.all
  homs2 <- paste(substr(x...@loc.all, 3, 3), substr(x...@loc.all, 3, 3), sep = "")
  xx <- matrix(NA, ncol = ncol(x_mat), nrow = nrow(x_mat))
  for (i in 1:nrow(x_mat)) {
    for (ii in 1:ncol(x_mat)) {
      inp <- x_mat[i, ii]
      if (!is.na(inp)) {
        if (inp == 0)
          xx[i, ii] <- homs1[ii]
        else if (inp == 1)
          xx[i, ii] <- hets[ii]
        else if (inp == 2)
          xx[i, ii] <- homs2[ii]
      } else{
        xx[i, ii] <- NA
      }
    }
  }
  xx <- gsub("/", "", xx)
  xx <- as.data.frame(xx)
  rownames(xx) <- indNames(x)
  colnames(xx) <- locNames(x)
  return(xx)
}

res <- gl2calls(platypus.gl[1:10,1:10])
res

On Wednesday 17 July 2024 at 4:09:45 pm UTC+10 Jose Luis Mijangos wrote:
Hi Colin,

For some reason google groups reformatted the code, it changed "x...@loc.all" by "x...@loc.all", I guess google groups thinks it is an e-mail address. Let's see if it happens again in the code below.

Luis 

gl2calls <- function(x){
  x_mat <- as.matrix(x[, ])
  homs1 <- paste(substr(x...@loc.all, 1, 1), substr(x...@loc.all, 1, 1), sep = "")
  hets <- x...@loc.all
  homs2 <- paste(substr(x...@loc.all, 3, 3), substr(x...@loc.all, 3, 3), sep = "")
  xx <- matrix(NA, ncol = ncol(x_mat), nrow = nrow(x_mat))
  for (i in 1:nrow(x_mat)) {
    for (ii in 1:ncol(x_mat)) {
      inp <- x_mat[i, ii]
      if (!is.na(inp)) {
        if (inp == 0)
          xx[i, ii] <- homs1[ii]
        else if (inp == 1)
          xx[i, ii] <- hets[ii]
        else if (inp == 2)
          xx[i, ii] <- homs2[ii]
      } else{
        xx[i, ii] <- NA
      }
    }
  }
  xx <- gsub("/", "", xx)
  xx <- as.data.frame(xx)
  rownames(xx) <- indNames(x)
  colnames(xx) <- locNames(x)
  return(xx)
}

      inp <- x_mat[i, ii]
      if (!is.na(inp)) {

          xx[i, ii] <- hets[ii]
        else if (inp == 2)
          xx[i, ii] <- homs2[ii]
      } else{
